title: Browser test report of one page state (design comparison only)

design_diffs_total.description: All design differences found at this viewport, also those cut off by the limit of 200 listed in design_diffs; 0 when the design check was skipped

design_diffs.description: Differences from the design mockup: per viewport at most 200 from the fingerprint and at most 10 more from the model; the exit code never depends on them

viewport.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT of the viewport the difference was seen at

block.description: data-block name, or "-" for the page as a whole

property.description: what differs, for example font-size, padding, texts, charts, order

note.description: what it means and the likely cause

source.description: fingerprint: copied from the fingerprint comparison; model: found by comparing take_snapshot of the mockup and the page
